parallelism.rule: UISR and product-development may execute concurrently on separate branches. Neither lane may pause/reprioritize the other. Shared Multiversal-app publication is serialized by the OPS3 merge lease and stale-base revalidation.

execution_rule: Each UISR tranche is a bounded ui-implementation work item carried through implementation, exact-head validation, serialized publication and lane-local closeout unless a genuine owner-only/external blocker is reached.
boundaries: UISR implements presentation only and may not become gameplay, permission, hidden-information, validation, provenance, AI or navigation authority.
Accessibility and reading preferences remain above Skin Pack presentation.
No target skin is runtime-complete until its separately governed implementation and Tier-C evidence exist.
UISR may not mutate MCS/product-development checkpoint state.
